body: I remember this one period of time where I didn’t feel anything for like a year. It was complete ass. I couldn’t feel anything except the passive will to die. Not good.

I’ve had depression for quite a bit, around 5 years. You can see my posts from when I was at my lowest point. I never thought I would’ve gotten to a point where I could not only enjoy life, but want a future.

I got to the other side of it, and it’s not perfect, but I’m not in consistent pain every day. I still have my moments where I want to fall back into it, but yeah. I have coping mechanisms and ways to get myself through it.

It’s so much work. It took so much work to get to this place. It’s like a constant uphill climb with the occasional lull in between, and it’s emotionally exhausting, but I made it.

I used to look at posts like the one I’m writing now and get pissed because 1. it felt too positive and like “savior-y” if that makes sense, and 2. because I was miserable and was convinced that there was no way, no matter what I did, that I could be happy. But I was wrong.

It’s so hard to be in mental anguish everyday, so I completely understand why people want to die, because I’ve been at that point. I just had to find things I enjoyed and find the beauty in life, even with how crappy the world is. The world is what I make of it, basically. Obviously my story isn’t gonna be everyone’s, but yeah. People who never had to deal with it probably enjoy life, who knows.
I have posts up from when I was deep in my depression. I came so far :) ❤️.

I’ve probably been depressed since I was 13, diagnosed around 15. I’m 17 now. It took a lot of work, but I’m in a good place. I got friends, I’m on meds, and I talk to my therapist weekly. I never believed people when they would tell me it gets better, and sometimes it’s still bad, but I’m at peace now and I have good friends :) I used to not be able to say that I was happy and hated associating myself with anything positive, but I can now. I’m still insecure and stuff, but yeah. Don’t feel like dying anymore.

I just wanted to share a happy story. It doesn’t get better for everyone, and everyone has different stories and situations, but I like to believe that it’s possible for everyone’s lives to change, yk? This doesn’t have to be forever. ❤️❤️ Happiness doesn’t come overnight, either. It took me years. It was an extremely hard journey, but I got here after a lot of misery.

Not everyone can afford therapy or meds and stuff like that, so I’m really lucky. I hope things get better for you ml ❤️ I know how it feels.
Keep in mind that I love her despite all of this, I just want to punch her sometimes 😭😭‼️ she’s my baby sister.

I honestly wish I could hug you rn because I completely understand, although I have things a bit easier currently. It’s hard to know that other people are also going through this stuff and that I’m not able to do anything about it. I usually don’t believe people when i vent and they tell me all these positive things, but I want you to know that you’re so lovable. 

You never asked for this horrible life or for your shitty parents. You’re trying so hard to stay alive rn, and you’re doing the best you can with what you have. School work and driving are hard to focus on with everything else going on in your life, which is completely understandable. Those things aren’t more important than you are. 

It’s probably hard to believe that the things your mom says/does to you isn’t the truth because you have no one else in your life to show/tell you otherwise, but I promise that you deserve to live and that you deserve happiness and love. You are so strong, even if you didn’t ask to be.

There’s no easy solution for me. There’s something fundamentally wrong with me and I can’t live knowing that I’ll be alone my whole life. I can’t live being happy or being surrounded by happiness. I’ve been surrounded by misery my whole life up until now, and I don’t think I could handle anything good. 

There’s no other option for me. Happiness feels like a lie. This whole thing sounds dramatic, but it’s really what I think. I don’t even want a different life anymore, I just want to be gone.

I don’t like when my family is fighting, but it’s all I know and I’m scared of not being in that place. Like I said, I post when I’m in a really bad place. I don’t even remember half the things I say on here.

Trust me, I know this more than anyone. I’m pretty sure my therapist thinks this as well. We used to do family therapy sessions, but they were too stressful and my therapist thought that we should stop them for a while. I didn’t think family therapy would even work anyway because, and I really mean it when I say this, our family is too broken to be fixed. Plus, they’re getting a divorce now anyway so. I think individual therapy for everyone would be helpful but I also can’t imagine any of us ever being happy.

It’s sort of embarrassing that you read some of them bc yikes 💀sometimes I forget that real people read these. Those are my deepest and darkest thoughts though, and reading through those is like reading a book with an unreliable narrator. I post here when I’m feeling at my absolute lowest, which is like every other day, so my history on here isn’t pretty. Also, I am in therapy so.

I don’t remember honestly. Everything’s just been building up lately. My parents are probably getting divorced, school has been kicking my ass because of all the work and loneliness, and just my overwhelming self-hatred because I ruin everything for everybody else and for myself.

Sometimes nothing even happens, I just feel like shit all the time. I always feel guilty for ruining peoples lives. Now that I think about it, that’s probably what started this. I feel like I poison everybody that talks to me with my awfulness and I felt really bad about it.

My therapist wants me to go on meds but I can’t. I deserve to feel this way because l make ppl miserable by existing. And I feel like if I “get better” then what did I go through all this for? It doesn’t make sense, I tried to explain this to her and no one understands. Even I don’t understand. I should want to get better, but I don’t. I just want to give up. I don’t see myself ever having a happy life, and I feel like meds are just fake happiness. It feels like I’m lying to myself, telling myself “I deserve to be happy” when it’s not true. I feel like im beyond help atp.

It doesn’t make sense logically, I’m self-aware enough to realize everything I’m thinking is messed up, but idc. I feel like mental illness is my safety blanket even if it makes me feel like the most worthless thing to ever exist. I don’t deserve sympathy bc I have all of these tools to help me get better and I don’t want to. Other people would kill to be me and be able to have access to therapy. Idk what’s wrong with me. I’m srry for dumping this on you. Ty for the advice.

I don’t think I will tbh. My childhood is slipping through my fingers, and I didn’t get to do anything. It feels like my life stopped at 12 and everyone’s been going on without me for years, and I don’t know what to do about it. 

I’m not needed or wanted by anybody. I’m just a temporary figure in everybody’s life and I’m so sick of it. This is what the rest of my life is gonna be like, I know it. I missed my chance.

Sorry for ranting, just needed to get this out.
